svg.aria-label: Deckhand opening picture: the Deckhand bollard icon and wordmark with the AceEngineer wordmark; the Deckhand icon holds a rope that rises over three pale bands, the cost cycles, to the crane of a semi-submersible platform at sea, tracing the rise of offshore project costs over twenty-five years; the title Offshore mega-project cost inflation over time
